children.text: The Kenya tourist visa allows the holder a short-term tourist visit to Kenya.

The e-visa application is submitted on the website designated by the Kenyan government, and the decision is made by the Kenyan immigration authority.
On this website, you fill out the visa application, upload the required documentation, and pay the visa fee.

page.title: How do I apply for a Kenya visa?

children.text:
🔹 A detailed list of documents tailored to your travel purpose.
🔹 Completion of the application form.
🔹 Professional review of the documentation you provide.
🔹 Phone and online support.
🔹 Payment of the visa fee.
🔹 The highest standard of personal data protection.
Before the application is approved, the applicant must complete the following steps:

🔹 Gathering the required documents and completing the application form.
🔹 Paying the visa fee.
🔹 Receiving the visa decision.
Processing of the Kenya visa application begins once the application is submitted and takes up to 3 business days.
The Kenya tourist e-visa is issued with single-entry rights, valid for the exact period stated in the application and documentation.

page.title: How long is the visa valid?

children.text: Passport (valid for at least 6 more months)
Flight reservation
Proof of accommodation
Photo
Additional documentation (invitation letter, and others)
Make sure to include all required information in your application.
Make sure your passport is valid for at least six months from your planned return date.
If you have additional supporting documents, they must be in English.
It's recommended to submit your visa application at least 2 weeks before your trip. However, the applicant can apply at most 3 months in advance.
It's important to remember, and not exceed, the rights and obligations granted by your visa category.

content.text: What are my chances of getting a visa?

children.text: It's difficult to predict the likelihood of a specific applicant being granted a visa. However, it's clear that this depends on your close ties to your home country. Clear proof of your travel purpose is also important.

content.text: How do I check my visa status?

children.text: https://evisa.go.ke/evisa.html –

content.text: Does the eConsul guarantee the visa?

children.text: No one else can interfere with the consul's decision on issuing a visa. This decision is final. However, our qualified professionals will do everything possible to prepare your documents properly and in your favor for the consulate, so the consul fully understands your current circumstances and prospects, which increases the likelihood of the visa being granted.

content.text: How long does it take for the visa to be issued?

children.text: The visa is issued within 3 business days after the application is uploaded.
